"""Fixture: refusal reason unsupported-shape (hand)."""

from agent_workflows import artifact_meta


def test_unsupported_shape_unknown_field() -> None:
    text = (
        "# IPD: Unknown Field Plan\n\n"
        "- Id: us1001\n"
        "- Status: approved\n"
        "- Custom-Unknown-Field: mystery\n"
    )
    st = artifact_meta.read_text(text, record_type="ipd")
    assert st.id6 == "us1001"
    assert st.status == "approved"
